articles.title: Don't Leave Yet! Toy Story 5 Packs Multiple Post-Credits Surprises
articles.summary: Toy Story 5 isn't done when the credits roll — it hides a mid-credits scene and a final post-credits stinger. They're not crucial to the plot, but fans will want to stick around for these bonus moments.

articles.title: One Leg, Zero Gravity: John McFall Could Redefine Who Goes to Space
articles.summary: Paralympian-turned-surgeon John McFall may become the first physically disabled astronaut, flying to the Haven-1 commercial space station in 2027. His unique body could offer surprising advantages in microgravity.

articles.title: A Clock That Ticks Inside an Atom's Core Could Unlock New Physics
articles.summary: Physicists have demonstrated the first working nuclear clock, using thorium-229's nucleus as a timekeeper. It ran for 24 hours and could outperform atomic clocks while searching for dark matter and a fifth force.
